info.title: PDF Files API Reference
info.description: Retrieve a list of all PDF files uploaded and generated by a user. Returns an array of file objects with file ID and file name. Note: Organization members cannot access this endpoint — only the Organization Administrator can.

tags: Task Status and File Info APIs
get.description: This API retrieves a list of all PDF files uploaded and generated by a specific user. Please note that if the user is part of an organization, only the Organization Administrator can access this endpoint. Organization Members cannot access this endpoint.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specifies the desired format for the API response. Choose 'json' for a JSON object or 'xml' for an XML structure.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

PdfFileListResponse.description: PDF file list response containing an array of file objects.

files.description: List of files available on the server.

PdfFileItem.description: A single PDF file in the file list.

fileId.description: Unique ID for the file, used to fetch or process the file.

fileName.description: Original name of the uploaded file.
